entities.name: MBS Interest Indication procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by an MBS capable UE in RRC_CONNECTED state to indicate its interest in MBS broadcast services.

entities.name: MBSInterestIndication message
entities.description: RRC message transmitted by UE to indicate MBS broadcast frequencies/services of interest and prioritization.

entities.name: RRC_CONNECTED state
entities.description: RRC state where UE has an established RRC connection with the network.

entities.name: System Information Block 21
entities.description: System information block containing MBS broadcast configuration information.

entities.name: System Information Block 20
entities.description: System information block containing MBS service configuration information.

entities.name: mbs-FreqList
entities.description: List of MBS broadcast frequencies of interest included in MBS Interest Indication.

entities.name: mbs-ServiceList
entities.description: List of MBS broadcast services of interest included in MBS Interest Indication.

entities.name: SIB21 provided by PCell
entities.description: Condition where the serving PCell broadcasts SIB21.

entities.name: SIB20 provided by PCell
entities.description: Condition where the serving PCell broadcasts SIB20.

entities.name: MBS broadcast frequencies of interest not empty
entities.description: Condition where the UE has at least one MBS broadcast frequency of interest.

entities.name: MBS broadcast frequencies of interest changed
entities.description: Condition where the set of MBS broadcast frequencies differs from previous indication.

entities.name: Prioritization of MBS broadcast reception changed
entities.description: Condition where prioritization between MBS broadcast and unicast reception has changed.

entities.name: MBS broadcast services of interest changed
entities.description: Condition where the set of MBS broadcast services differs from previous indication.

relations.description: Procedure can only be initiated when UE is in RRC_CONNECTED state.
Procedure includes transmission of MBSInterestIndication message.
Procedure execution is guarded by SIB21 availability condition.
Procedure execution is guarded by SIB20 availability condition.
Non-empty frequency list condition establishes message transmission.
Changed frequency list condition establishes message transmission.
Changed prioritization condition establishes message transmission.
Changed service list condition establishes message transmission.
